name: avoid
description: AMSI and ETW patching: replace the scan and telemetry entry points in this process's memory with failure and silence -- evasion.avoid's execution half packed as the artifact an implant loads through module.load.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and one artifact file under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver. On the target, the implant half loads from staged task content and the patch lands in the process's own memory -- nothing on disk. The scope is exactly that process: the effect dies with it, and a new process loads fresh libraries. AMSI failure telemetry and ETW inline-hook detection are live blue-team surfaces; the verb is sensitive (Evasion category, modifies-defenses attribute), held out of unattended firing by the registry-backed policy, and the plugin rides the per-engagement module load -- never a default profile.
